description: This file defines classes related to test configuration management, including TestConfiguration, SpecifierSorter, and TestConfigurationConverter, used for handling test configuration specifications, sorting, macro expansion, and conversion between configurations and specifier lists.

classes.name: TestConfiguration
classes.description: Represents a test configuration with properties like version, architecture, and build type.

classes.name: SpecifierSorter
classes.description: Handles sorting and categorization of test specifiers, including macro expansion.

classes.name: TestConfigurationConverter
classes.description: Converts between sets of test configurations and lists of specifiers, including macro collapsing and set operations.

methods.name: category_order
methods.description: Returns the order of configuration categories.

methods.name: items
methods.description: Returns the items of the configuration as key-value pairs.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns the keys of the configuration.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: String representation of the TestConfiguration instance.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: Official string representation of the TestConfiguration instance.

methods.name: __hash__
methods.description: Hash function for the configuration.

methods.name: __eq__
methods.description: Equality comparison between configurations.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns the configuration values as a tuple.

methods.name: add_specifier
methods.description: Adds a specifier to the category mapping.

methods.name: add_macros
methods.description: Adds macros to the specifier categorization.

methods.name: category_priority
methods.description: Returns the priority index of a category.

methods.name: specifier_priority
methods.description: Returns the priority of a specifier based on its category.

methods.name: category_for_specifier
methods.description: Retrieves the category for a given specifier.

methods.name: sort_specifiers
methods.description: Sorts a list of specifiers based on category priority.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the TestConfigurationConverter with configurations and macros.

methods.name: specifier_sorter
methods.description: Returns the SpecifierSorter instance.

methods.name: _expand_macros
methods.description: Expands macros into their constituent specifiers.

methods.name: to_config_set
methods.description: Converts a list of specifiers into a set of TestConfiguration instances.

methods.name: collapse_macros
methods.description: Collapses macros within specifier lists into combined specifiers.

methods.name: intersect_combination
methods.description: Computes intersection of multiple specifier sets.

methods.name: symmetric_difference
methods.description: Computes the symmetric difference across multiple sets.

methods.name: to_specifiers_list
methods.description: Converts a set of TestConfiguration instances into specifier lists.
